text.card: A red giant 4,246 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.90 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,870 K at its surface.
